result.summary: Found 1 layout issue where a restaurant card in the horizontal carousel is vertically misaligned with its sibling cards.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, the middle card ('Smash Bros Burgers') is shifted downward compared to the adjacent cards ('Green Bowl Poké' and 'Trattoria Piccola'), breaking the vertical alignment of the row.
issues.suggestion: Remove any top margin or vertical offset on the middle carousel item and ensure all cards in the horizontal scroll container are top-aligned (`align-items: flex-start`).
